sets.relationshipLabel: A thing and a feature it simply has
sets.explanation: A wall naturally has a window and a roof naturally has a chimney — each pair names a whole and a feature it possesses, no story required.

sets.relationshipLabel: A collection and the kind of thing it is made of
sets.explanation: A toolbox is made of wrenches and a crew is made of masons — both pairs link a collective noun to the unit that fills it.

sets.relationshipLabel: A place and the activity it exists for
sets.explanation: A site exists for construction and a workshop exists for woodworking — each place is defined by the activity it houses.

sets.relationshipLabel: Opening moment of a project facing its closing moment
sets.explanation: Groundbreaking opens a project as ribbon-cutting closes it, just as excavation begins a build and occupancy ends it — start paired against finish.
